statements.text: Salt stirred completely into water until nothing separate can be seen is a uniform mixture.
Roasted chana mixed with raisins and curry leaves is a non-uniform mixture.
Mustard oil floating as a layer on water is a uniform mixture.

stem:
Mehak prepares mixtures at home. In a uniform mixture the components are spread so evenly that they cannot be seen separately.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Fully dissolved salt water is uniform; chana with separate pieces is non-uniform; oil floating on water still shows separate parts, so it is not uniform.
